findings: `locals()` guards always true (main path) — `clip_name` and `v_status` are assigned unconditionally in both try and except branches before db.insert; the guards are dead code that would silently swallow a future refactor. Remove them and reference the fields directly. (confirmed)

`simulate` blocks the event loop — `time.sleep(0.5)` in the route handler runs on the async event loop after the threadpool await resolves, blocking the entire server for up to 1.5 s per call. Fix: `await asyncio.sleep(0.5)`. (confirmed)

`to_event` hard-indexes `r["status"]`; in-memory row dicts supply `"status": "new"` so it works today, but any future caller that omits the field will get a KeyError from every code path that calls to_event. (likely)
